name: mcp-tvsubtitles
description: MCP server for tvsubtitles.net. Search TV series, read a season's subtitle coverage and one record, with the page to download it. No API key required.
long_description: Search television series on tvsubtitles.net, see which languages cover each episode of a season, and read one subtitle's record with the release it was cut for. No API key, no account.

tools.name: search_titles
tools.description: Find a television series by name.

tools.name: list_subtitles
tools.description: Read a season's language coverage, or one episode's subtitle records.

tools.name: get_subtitle
tools.description: Read one record, with its release and the page to download it.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List the languages the catalogue holds, or the ones one show holds.
